notes.title: Perfect Lover~Fragile Love First Release Discount Restoration!
notes.content:
Perfect Lover~Fragile Love First Release Discount Restoration!

经过了长达一周的等待，我们8月12日发布的百合游戏《完美恋人》商店页面存在的BUG终于全部修复，目前已经能够成功购买并且有持续14天的首发折扣（虽然已经过了首发时间...）

这几天真是忙的焦头烂额，steam客服的回复非常缓慢并且敷衍，给大家造成了不便还请谅解！

《完美恋人》是XUWULE游戏工作室制作的一款百合题材视觉小说，游戏目前已经发布于steam平台。首发18元，折后价16.2元，打折14天。

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2773520

之前添加愿望单还未购买，或是还没有关注的小伙伴们，赶紧入手吧！
QQ群：806366756

notes.title: 第二部独立百合galgame《完美恋人~fragile love 》商店界面已公开！
notes.content:
第二部独立百合galgame《完美恋人~fragile love 》商店界面已公开！

这是一个关于承诺与救赎的故事。

她们是儿时形影不离的玩伴，再见时却形同陌路...

她们互看不顺眼，却又互相吸引，

她们是水火不容的对头，又是天生一对的恋人... 

游戏由XUWULE制作组独立开发（剧本，程序和美术三人。）

B站主页：https://space.bilibili.com/458943

steam商店：https://store.steampowered.com/app/2773520

微博账号：https://weibo.com/u/6907622134

QQ群：806366756

第二部作品弥补了首个作品中出现的许多缺点，也终于找到了合适的画师和CV。
剧情方面如果第一部合你胃口，那么第二部绝对不会让你失望！

喜欢的小伙伴可以支持一下！

商店界面还在完善，后续更加详细的资料也会陆续上传，宣传片，游戏实况，以及一个demo版的发布！

详细请关注个人动态!

notes.title: 收集反馈和更新预告
notes.content:
溢爱~Fragile love has been released for over a week now. First of all, thank you to all players for playing and supporting!

Initially, we planned to give the first game a try and then move on to the production of the second game. However, we received a lot of feedback and feedback, so we will conduct optimization and updates next week. 1. Proofread and modify the text content. 2. Optimization of character portraits. 3. CG increase

Due to a total of two producers, the CV dubbing was found online, and the original CV dubbing cannot be found anymore. The script content will not be modified.

Many people have also mentioned the issue of previous vertical painting, and due to limited personal skills and funding, the use of AI assisted production did not produce satisfactory results. They have already arranged for a painter to redraw.

Welcome everyone to join the group and provide feedback. We will try our best to make changes.



Regarding the new work:

It is expected to be released around May next year, and the script is nearing completion, but further evaluation and revision are needed. Simultaneously selecting artists.

Welcome to the group 806366756 to evaluate the new script, which will facilitate us to make modifications as soon as possible. It is important for us to listen to the opinions of readers. Thank you!
